name: Moj Sychik
source: The hero's path is a beautiful and terrifying phenomenon. Every character in his story goes through this thorny path and I was no exception. Ten years of meaningless existence, the pursuit of an empty and cruel dream, in the end, the loss of everything. After walking part of the way in utter darkness, I plunged into the bright, beautiful seven days of summer. But as it turned out, the road closed into a single circle. From Hell to Heaven and back, taking with me a piece of heaven — the legacy of the one who was able to heal my heart.
